buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses PR NO : 1006309302 Note: Only Designer recommended source is eligible to participate in the tender. 1. Technical Specifications & Drawings as per Appendix-A and Quality Assurance Plan for” EMI/EMC Filter ( Part Num- 113083693384) without Flange for MPATGM “as per Appendix-B. 2. All the deliverables will be verified for the Part / Article / Drg. Number (wherever applicable) with the par t/ article/Drg. number given in the Purchase order. 3. (a) Inspection Agency: BDL and MSQAA. (b) Pre-inspection at firm i.e M/s BEL Bangalore is not applicable M/s BEL Bangalore will supply the items al ong with Certificate of conformance/ Test Reports. (c) Acceptance criteria: All the deliverables will be accepted based on the complete test reports /Manufact urer’s COC / Self conformity certificate to be supplied along with the items. (d) Final acceptance at BDL after receiving the material 100% visual inspection and verification of COCs. 4. Delivery schedule: within 12 weeks from the date of receipt of Purchase order. 5. (a) The supplier shall ensure to reach the items with the required quality to BDL through adequate pack aging without any damage. (b) Replacement for the rejected components shall be provided on Priority basis at free of cost. (c) The components should be free from Defects & Damages. 6. (a) The components are to be supplied /manufactured as per specifications/ Article No./Part numbers. (b) The changes, if any, as and when received from DRDL, the same will be intimated for and correction. (c) Identification/Traceability number should be marked on each Item. 7. The components shall be delivered to BDL stores (F.O.R BDL, Kanchanbagh, Hyderabad, Telangana Stat e-500058) at free of cost. 8. (a) Suitable Measuring Instruments and Gauges shall be available with the manufacturer for all basic ins pection (Wherever applicable). (b) Wherever facility for inspection is not available with the vendor, the inspection shall be done by the ve ndor at any of ISO/NABL certified Laboratory. 9. Warranty: One year from the date of acceptance of material at BDL, Kanchanbagh, Hyderabad. 10. Payment terms: (a) 90% basic value + 100% taxes will be paid within 30 days after receipt and acceptance of items at BDL . (b) Balance 10% will be paid against submission of Performance Bank Guarantee (PBG) for 5 % PO value v alid till warranty period plus 3 months claim period. (c) In case of non-submission of PBG, 10 % payment will be released after satisfactory completion of warra nty period only. 11. Supplier shall not supply non-conforming product/Items against specification. 12. Supplier shall retain the product related records (Processes, Quality Records etc.) up to 3years.

13. Supplier shall ensure that the persons carrying out the manufacturing of items under this purchase ord er be aware of Product conformity requirements, Product safety and Importance of ethical behaviour etc. 14. The Successful bidder will be debarred / blacklisted for the future tenders for a period as decided by B DL, if the bidder deviates from the agreed terms & conditions after the award of Purchase Order / Work Or der / Service Order apart from forfeiture of your EMD. 15. Benefit of ITC Clause: (a) Benefit of Input Tax Credit should be passed on to BDL without fail. (b) Benefit of reduction in rate of GST applicable for the supply, compared to the rate of GST as per the Co ntract, should be passed on to BDL without fail. (c) A Certificate duly signed by the Company Secretary/ Director/ CFO/ Managing partner/ Proprietor, as th e case may be, should be furnished along with the quotation in the following format. “Certified that the benefit of input tax credit and /or rate reduction has been duly and commensurately pas sed on in terms of section 171 of the CGST Act.” 16. GST Clause: "BDL reserves its right to release GST only after supplier's invoice/debit note is reflected in GSTR-2B/2A within the specified time limit mentioned in GST law". 17. LD Clause: “Time is the essence of the P.O and delivery should be strictly insisted upon according to th e delivery schedule given in the SOs/POs. In the event the supplier fails to deliver the goods / service, withi n the stipulated delivery period, BDL reserves the right to recover from the supplier, LD and not by way of penalty an amount as detailed in terms and conditions. A sum of 0.5% of the price only of the stores (Inclu ding duties, taxes) which the supplier has failed to deliver as aforesaid for each week of delay or part there of, subject to a maximum of 10%. In case of extension of delivery period, increase in taxes shall not be bor ne by BDL, if delay is attributable to vendor”. 18. All Other Terms & conditions are applicable as per the General / Limited Terms and conditions attached . . 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer uploaded ATC document Click here to view the file. 3. Generic Bidder shall submit the following documents along with their bid for Vendor Code Creation: a. Copy of PAN Card. b. Copy of GSTIN. c. Copy of Cancelled Cheque. d. Copy of EFT Mandate duly certified by Bank.
